notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy Patch #5 and Consoles Launch
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

Today we have a small new update for you that addresses some minor issues and also adds a few new features! We have also added Catalan language. You can find the full list down below.

Additionally, today we are happy to let you know that The Kindeman Remedy will be available on PS4|5, Xbox Series and Xbox One, and also the Nintendo Switch! For those of you who would like to try the game on consoles, you now have the option to do so! You can watch the trailer here.


 Added a new 'special treatment' to unlock: the Bath Tub
 Added Screen Resolution option to Graphic Settings
 Added Catalan localization
 Added 'special treatments' list in the Prescription Book: you can check which treatments you already performed on inmates
 Fixed some cutscenes: corrected some compenetrations with objects
 Fixed Drips and Poison tutorial: locked useless doors during tutorials

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/e52f07b9d8d2cb643a25149ffa47b738e638da6c.png

Hey everyone, we've got a small new update just in time for the holidays for you!


 NEW!: We added a brand new gameplay section for Sister Anna; she can now make poison from mushrooms and pesticide into the Warehouse (Please note that you'll need to start a new run in order to do it)
 Fixed Oliver's behavior when carrying bodies; now he'll take bodies to the incinerator as intended 
 Fixed an issue where lights in the Drip Room were off during gameplay
 Fixed an issue where players would unlock Pills Dispenser 2, but be unable to use it
 Refactored the Daytime/Nighttime Report UI with improved icons and layout

If you're just discovering the game, you can pick it up for 10% off during the Steam Winter Sale ⬇️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055410/The_Kindeman_Remedy/

We'll see you all in the new year! Happy holidays everyone, and thank you for all your feedback and support on The Kindeman Remedy!

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/becb7ccbdf558b57c2879ff14f9f50bd22aac93c.png

Greetings everyone,

We are back with a new update that addresses some of the issues that have been reported by the community! Once again, thanks to everyone for sharing your feedback with us!

Here is the list of what is included with this update:


 Added camera pan (hold the right mouse button or use the gamepad's right stick)
 Added Enhanced Lighting to Graphic Settings
 Added Gore Death for poisoned inmates (you need to enable the Gore option in the Game Settings Tab)
 Fixed the assistant's velocity when he's carrying a corpse
 Fixed some cutscenes
 Fixed Percy's dialogues
 Made object icons clickable (you can interact with an object by clicking on its icon as well)
 Room icons appear as soon as an inmate enters a room
 Replaced Corpse Disposal with Incinerator
 Greyed out inactive rooms
 Increased Freight Lifter speed
 Increased guard's speed when he's dropping a corpse in the Morgue
 Increased Chemical Desk speed
 Increased Morgue Table speed

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/9ef9ea3940fb6f65f7f84da5f357f8a101832cf7.png

Greetings everyone,

Not so long since we released the first patch, we've already prepared the second update that addresses several issues and bugs that we've managed to fix based on your feedback!

Without further ado, here is the list of everything that this update includes:


 FIXED: Inmates stuck at the end of the day
 FIXED: Execution cutscene incongruences
 FIXED: Crash related to Secret Room
 FIXED: Pause Menu stuck in Settings
 IMPROVED: Changed/improved Interactable positions in some rooms (Lab / Drip Room) to allow for faster gameplay
 IMPROVED: We switched to a new rendering system for enhanced graphics/lighting. This system requires DX12 compatible cards though. The game was tested on a nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 (with steady 60fps) and nvidia GeForce GTX 1050 (around 20-22fps). In order to test this new system you need to switch to the Beta Branch on Steam (read the instructions below)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/290df8ddf6e3d7fc29c3d576abaa9e9d51de8e69.png

How do I opt-in in the Beta Branch?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/841513f63d13bf4f46b167a9d7e880a6b44f46c4.png

A - Right-click on the The Kindeman Remedy in your Steam client's Library tab

B - Select the Betas option on the left (1), then type TheKindemanRemedyBeta into the text field (2) and click on the Check Code button (3)

C - Click on the Opt into: beta - Experimental features button

Thanks again to everyone sharing feedback! Stay tuned for more updates coming in the future.

notes.title: The Kindeman Remedy - Patch 1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43793718/49627c47cee818cc4ca6117b4e7ebaaacf8df13c.png

We heard you loud and clear: on popular demand, we increased Dr. Kindeman and Oliver's movement speed while carrying bodies down in the Morgue.

Now you also have 4 carts for the drips.

While we were at it, we fixed some localization problems (especially with Italian language) and other game loading bugs.

Here's the full change list:


 Increased characters' movement speed while carrying bodies (Kindeman/Oliver)
 Localization: fixed wrong tags in Italian localization
 Fixed Oliver (assistant)'s behavior
 Fixed Phone bug when loading a game
 Fixed Pippi bug when loading a game
 Added Drip Cart N.4
 Fixed Minor and Major Report values when loading a game
 Fixed Sister Anna's cloth mesh compenetrations
 Added a new Credits screen


Enjoy and stay tuned for more improvements/fixes/updates in the next few days!

-- Troglobytes
